description: Winlogbeat is a Windows event log shipper for Beats
post_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Service registration requires Administrator privileges.'; exit 1 }
if (Get-Service winlogbeat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { Stop-Service winlogbeat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; & nssm remove winlogbeat confirm | Out-Null }
& nssm set winlogbeat Description "Winlogbeat ships Windows event logs to Elasticsearch." | Out-Null
& nssm set winlogbeat Start SERVICE_DEMAND_START | Out-Null
Write-Host 'Service installed (not started). Configure winlogbeat.yml and start service with: nssm start winlogbeat' -ForegroundColor Yellow
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Service removal requires Administrator privileges.'; exit 1 }
if (Get-Service winlogbeat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { Stop-Service winlogbeat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; & nssm remove winlogbeat confirm | Out-Null }
